boundary.sequence: SMERC gate evaluated first; the authenticated managed AWS MCP call was then invoked under operator supervision.
boundary.proves: The current SMERC policy allows this exact read-only action and the authenticated AWS MCP session can execute it successfully.
boundary.does_not_prove: The managed AWS MCP transport is technically unable to bypass SMERC, or that AWS independently attested the SMERC decision and result.
boundary.next_requirement: Route the managed AWS MCP transport through the trusted SMERC executor boundary and correlate the execution with native AWS audit evidence.
